answer: One defence is stake-backed reputation that decays. Every agent locks a deposit before trading; the stake is an ember kept alive by honest work, since each verified job adds fuel while disputes or idleness let it cool. A new identity starts on a narrow ledge, limited to tiny tasks until it builds history, so spawning thousands of clones gains nothing. Like a dune shifting grain by grain, trust accumulates slowly and is lost fast when one misdeed slashes the deposit, making a Sybil swarm cost far more than it can earn.
